record.title: Evaluate stock composition and select the next externally unsatisfied initialization dependency
record.intent: Advance from proved application state toward minimum useful instrument personality without unnecessary transform analysis.
requirements: Distinguish direct observation, static linkage and untraced-thread uncertainty.
Evaluate thread coverage before admitting more modeled device responses.
acceptance: Select a bounded thread-coverage or next-dependency observation batch from actual evidence.
Commit and push conclusions before the next experiment.
